verdict.rationale: Foreloop documents no native scheduler for recurring jobs. Its CLI is explicitly meant to be driven from cron (foreloop-docs-16), and connected agents poll for approved tasks "on a cadence" (foreloop-docs-37), so recurring automation is only possible by pairing it with external scheduling. missing for 10: a first-party scheduling feature for recurring jobs or workflows, user-configurable schedules or cadence settings, documentation of what "loops" are and whether they recur, independent or hands-on corroboration.
